name: @coding-adventures/forme-doc-page-shell
description: RTD-minimal two-column HTML page-shell: sidebar on the left, content in the middle, optional in-page TOC on the right.  Header bar with site title / GitHub link / search input; footer with version / 'edit this page' link / copyright.  Emits { head, body } HTML chunks suitable for `forme-aot-html-doc-emitter` to wrap into a full document.  All user-supplied strings HTML-escaped; URL scheme allowlist defeats `javascript:` injection.  Pure transform, capability [].  DOC00 v0 site-structure package.
author: Adhithya Rajasekaran
